targets.outcome_quote: We found that the indirect effect of malice motive on revenge is positive but marginally significant (alpha = .0715596, se = .038782, p = .065). The claim was not replicated at 5% level of significance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The report explicitly concludes that the single focal claim was not replicated at the preregistered 5% significance threshold.
